values.note: Moccasin Branch: no-hookup site $30, full-hookup RV site $45 a night, both including the $3 reservation fee. Campers 62 or older and veterans or active military get $6 off per night.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping ('Camping Rates per Night ... All prices listed on the page include the $3 reservation fee': full hookups at Moccasin Branch $45, no hookups $30), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping ('Nine RV sites (sites 11 to 18 and 22) offer full hookups with 50-amp, 30-amp, and a 20-amp outlet for all RV needs, as well as full water and sewer'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 9 full-hookup RV sites (11-18, 22; 22 accessible) with long driveways, listed at 67 ft, back-in; 15 drive-to tent-and-trailer sites without hookups (1-10, 19-21, 23-24), each with a 25 x 25 ft tent pad, no length listed. Plus 6 camper cabins.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping ('Long driveways can accommodate RVs of all sizes', 'Fifteen additional sites ... provide a "drive-to" experience for tent and trailer campers') + ReserveAmerica site list for loop 'Moccasin Branch Campground' (9 Campsite Electric '67 Back-In', 15 Campsite Non-Electric 'Back-In'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouse with toilets and hot showers; water spigots around the loop; firewood sold at the campground (cash only).

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping ('The campground has a bathhouse with toilets and hot showers available to all campers. There are also potable water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/raven-rock-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552835 ('Status: Open year round'; campsites bookable Oct 22 2026 - Apr 22 2027), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Reservations are required for all types of camping at Raven Rock - no walk-ups permitted.' Up to 6 months ahead and for the same day; 14 consecutive nights in any 30 days. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 when booking within 14 days. Go straight to the site; staff come round to check in. $6/night cancellation fee.

booking.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping (Making Reservations; Changes and Cancellations) + https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/raven-rock-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552835 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $6 off per night for campers 62 or older and for veterans and active military, on most reservations (not group sites); tick the discount box when booking and bring ID.

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park/camping ('Campers 62 years old or older and any veteran or active military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on most reservations (except group campsites)'), read 2026-10-22

note: Moccasin Branch Campground (opened ~2023), at 814 Moccasin Branch Road just before the park's main entrance. The hookup sites have long driveways; the no-hookup sites are drive-to tent-and-trailer sites with large tent pads. 6 camper cabins. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50-amp full hookups (9 sites), showers, $30/$45 incl. $3 reservation fee, ReserveAmerica booking. Added 24 sites (9 hookup at 67 ft, 15 no-hookup), flush toilets, water, year-round, no walk-ups, 6-month window, 14-night max, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days, $6/night senior/veteran/military discount. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Registry state:NC says walk-up sites exist (fcfs some_sites) and the holiday waiver is 7 days; this park says 'no walk-ups permitted' (recorded fcfs never) and ReserveAmerica says the holiday minimum lifts within 14 days (recorded 14).
The 15 no-hookup sites (the $30 base) are described as 'for tent and trailer campers' and list no length on ReserveAmerica; a 23-ft motorhome may be better placed on a $45 full-hookup site.
